messages:
maria-eng: Heads-up — we're seeing a spike of 503s from embeddings service in eu-west1 (small-batch path). Patch ready (fix NPE in batch router). Need expedited deploy approval. @dana-oncall @sam-release @leo-sre

sam-release: +1 to fast-track. How confident on the fix? any perf regressions?

maria-eng: unit + integration passes. Perf locally looks flat. Will push new image in ~8m.

leo-sre: We should define rollback criteria before deploy. Propose: error-rate > 1.5x baseline for 5m OR p50 latency increase > 2x for 5m. Also prefer limited blast radius (eu-west1 only).

ops-deploybot: deploybot: /deploy start hotfix/embeds-fix image:sha256:beefcafe requested-by:maria-eng mode:canary target:eu-west1 pct:10

dana-oncall: Deploybot acknowledged. Oncall will monitor. I approve expedited canary with 10% traffic shift.

leah-product: Thx for the heads-up. Product is +1; customers impacted by this are in EU and we need the fix live. Please include a short release note.

maria-eng: Drafted release note: https://docs.redwood/release-notes/2026 - short summary + rollback steps.

sam-release: Who else needs to OK? ops-lead?

ops-lead: ops-lead: +1. Make sure tracing is on and add a temporary 1-minute alert for error-rate.

core-oncall: Dashboards updated: https://grafana.redwood/d/embeds/eu-west1 - I'll watch the error-rate and latency panels.

ops-deploybot: deploybot: canary rollout complete (10%) — health checks passed for 7m. error-rate down to baseline. Starting automated ramp to 100% over 3m.

maria-eng: Running smoke: ./scripts/smoke-embeds.sh — all checks green.

sam-release: Great. I mark this thread as expedited approved. I'll update changelog and release note.

ops-deploybot: deploybot: rollout 100% complete. image:sha256:beefcafe -> active. If rollback needed run: /rollback service:embeds image:sha256:feedface

dana-oncall: Post-deploy watch: hold for 20m, then lower the temporary alert threshold.

leah-product: :thumbsup: Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround.

maria-eng: Thanks team — closing out after watch window. Please ping if anything odd.
